plan.title: design-critique operator-gated loop until synthesis accepted

narratives.Description: Keep the design-critique arc in motion until the operator accepts a verified synthesis. Loop, verbs, dual-stop numbers, halt line, and `design-critique:triage-ready` live in the contract. Skill stays a thin pointer. No critic-posted chip. Do not edit the #3627 issue body.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3627. Parent #3434. Bindable SoT is successor lean comment 5383885131 (supersedes write-back 5383637041), plus Accept-X comments 5383705226, 5383711048, 5383720765, 5383729556, 5383736899, 5383741863, 5383754204, 5383773175, 5383780813, 5383785960, 5383800730. Critic 5383653662 is data. Issue body is historical; do not implement critic-posted from the body.
narratives.Overview: Dogfood on #3620 and #3596: round 1 is a disagreement map. A triage-ready stamp at critic-post binds a contested write-back. Recut: successor lean after accept-X; parent prints operator phrases; walk is optional; short forms of accept synthesis are valid; dual stop numbered (default 2 critic posts); halt line without a halt label; bind is triage:accept / scope:promote of the accepted synthesis, not Phase 3. Adjacent #3628 is a separate PR.
narratives.UserStory: As the operator after a critic posts, I want printed verbs (accept, retry differences, walk, accept synthesis) and a successor lean, so Phase-bind cannot fire on a contested write-back.
narratives.When: When the contract encodes the operator-gated loop, successor lean, printed verbs, numbered dual stop, halt line, triage-ready attach after accepted synthesis, ISSUE_LABELS.md and GitHub have design-critique:triage-ready only (no critic-posted), the skill stays a thin pointer under the line cap, and content-contract tests lock those pointer strings.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Do not edit the #3627 issue body. Do not add design-critique:critic-posted or any author/role chip. Critic does not write issue labels. Loop lives in the contract, not the skill. Each critic dispatch still EXITs after posting. ⊗ Auto-dispatch (#3578 / #1702). ⊗ Use Phase 3 or Stop 5 as operator commands. ⊗ Stamp triage-ready at critic-post. ⊗ Infer accept-synthesis from looks-good. Default critic posts = 2; third only with recorded why. Fingerprint = still-open finding headings/ids. Dispatch-fail is a separate halt. Halt line is design-critique: halted, because … with no halt label. Human authority for the bind; parent may post the synthesis-accepted line. Short forms of accept synthesis are valid. Walk comments stay slim. Full template only on successor lean / retry map. Do not close #3434. Do not implement #3628 in this PR (sequence 3628 first if both are in flight). Catalog home is .github/ISSUE_LABELS.md (#2609), not the consumer kit (#2611). Do not add triage-ready to judgmentGates labels.any-of.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Land contract Stop 4 / dual-stop / bind / verbs / successor lean / halt line / triage-ready attach. Thin skill pointer only (packs:render). ISSUE_LABELS.md + GitHub label design-critique:triage-ready. Content-contract tests. CHANGELOG Unreleased. Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts. Closes #3627. Refs #3434, ADR-005, #3578, #1702, #2442, #2609, #2611, #1423, #3607, #3620, #3596, #3628.
